description: Studio dependency bot — one branch per dependency updates EVERY workspace manifest that declares it (pnpm lockfile + all package.json files together), which is exactly the same-version-everywhere policy dependabot's per-directory mode cannot express. Enable by installing the Renovate GitHub App on codzxe/studio (github.com/apps/renovate); then DELETE .github/dependabot.yml so the two bots don't duplicate work.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major bumps into ONE weekly PR — keeps the apps/packages in lockstep without PR noise.
Major bumps stay INDIVIDUAL (migration-sized: typescript 7 is the Go rewrite, vitest 5, next 17...). Humans merge these deliberately.
Ecosystem-breaking majors this repo has NOT migrated to yet — never propose automatically.
The editor's Rust workspace is managed by cargo, not Renovate.
